title: A patch records its field list
statement: Let $K\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\Gamma$ and $P$ be types, let $x$ be a word over $\Gamma$, and let $d$ be a configuration with $K$ work tapes and state set $P$. Suppose tape $r$ of $d$ records the field list $f_s$ at every integer offset $p$ from its head position with $-1\le p\le L$, where $L$ is the length of the joined field word for $f_s$. If $g_s$ has the same joined-word length as $f_s$, then patching $d$ with state $q$ and fields $g_s$ makes tape $0$ record $g_s$ at every such offset from its head position.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration $d$ with $K+1$ work tapes and states in $P$
A field list $f_s$ recorded on tape $0$ at all offsets from $-1$ through its joined-word length
A field list $g_s$ with the same joined-word length as $f_s$
